subtitle-en: Banking in Motion: Designing for Cambodia
subtitle-ch: 行銀設計：打造符合柬埔寨需求的金融體驗
introduction-en: With rapid economic growth and increasing demand of banking service in Cambodia, our team started to devolop the mobile banking application from the ground up. We keep optimizing digital financial services to enhance reach and engagement in order to deepen local financial services and th build a business bass for subsidiary since 2018
introduction-ch: 隨著柬埔寨經濟快速發展，行動銀行需求大幅提升。本專案為UCB(銀行子行)打造在地化數位金融服務，自2018年由團隊從零建置，持續迭代功能與體驗，提升用戶觸及率與黏著度。

content-ch.title: 負責內容
content: 1. 2019｜UI 設計：延續既有風格，針對新功能提出設計解法
2. 2023｜UX 規劃：負責 Wireframe 與流程設計、重新梳理核心體驗
3. 建立設計規範 Library，並將工具從 Sketch 轉換為 Figma
4. 整合翻譯詞彙表、設計多語系介面（柬文、英文、中文）
5. 跨部門協作：與 PM、IT、BA 及柬國主管機關協作
6. 2024｜執行使用者研究：NPS、KANO 分析、易用性測試

highlight-content: 流程效能提升：導入 Figma 促進跨部門協作與即時設計溝通
系統化設計管理：建立設計系統與元件庫，整理 UI 元件與規範，提升接手效率並降低交接風險
用戶滿意度提升：自 2019 年起 NPS 淨推薦值穩定成長
更貼近在地需求：翻譯標準化與文化語境調整，提升理解與好感度。
數據導向決策：導入 KANO 模型提升需求優先度決策效率，降低試錯成本。

content-ch.title: 專案重點與挑戰
content-ch.subtitle: -語言與排版的挑戰
content: 柬埔寨國人主要使用語言有三種，App必須皆支援；因此在設計的時候，需要盡量保持介面上的彈性，不去限制文字區塊的寬度，方能載入三種語言時，在介面上完整顯示。
1. 設計上需避免文字區塊限制，確保不同語言皆能良好呈現
2. 建立翻譯對照表，標準化 Wording 並提升溝通效率

content-ch.subtitle: -用語的文化差異
content: 1. 初期使用 Transfer-in/out Account等專業術語，測試後改為當地更習慣的 From/To Account，提升用語親和力
2. 每次翻譯皆與當地人討論用語，提升認同感與理解度

content-ch.subtitle: -維護設計一致性
content: 此專案為大型維運專案，歷時長久，團隊成員人事變動頻繁，App經手許多設計師以及工程師，導致前後期產品元素及想法因人而異。為達成一致性，團隊決議轉換工具，由Sketch改為Figma，整理App設計規範，建立Components & Library，以確保未來接手之設計師有規範可遵循。

content-ch.subtitle: -使用習慣 vs 設計趨勢
content: 1. 東南亞用戶偏好「九宮格首頁」，與台灣常見個人化首頁不同，2023年團隊根據市場觀察調整為九宮格首頁，並追蹤競品設計走向。
2. 發現競品後續改版反而往個人化發展，團隊共同思考：設計該「迎合」當地習慣，或「引導」行為改變。

content-ch.title: 專案反思
content-ch.subtitle: -文化距離與用戶同理
content: 由於目標族群與我們有很大的文化差異，本案讓我意識到設計思維不能以自身經驗為中心，需深入觀察在地使用習慣並反覆驗證假設。未來若能在初期就投入更多使用者研究資源，將能更有效掌握市場趨勢與真實需求，打造更貼近人心的產品體驗。

content-ch.subtitle: -導入使用者研究分析需求
content: 因應本次「九宮格設計」專案的使用回饋，以及過往部分功能使用率偏低的經驗，團隊決議每年定期導入 KANO 分析，作為需求優先順序的客觀依據，協助業務單位聚焦關鍵功能，避免資源與時間浪費在低效開發上。

content-en.title: Responsibilities
content: 1. 2019｜UI Design：Extended existing design style and created new solutions to upcoming features.
2. 2023｜UX Design：Led wireframe and user flow redesign to improve the overall user experience.
3. Maintained a design system, and transferred the workflow from Sketch to Figma.
4. Designed multilingual interfaces (Khmer, English, Chinese) and maintained translation glossaries.
5. Collaborated across departments — working closely with PMs, ITs, BAs, and Cambodian authorities.
6. 2024｜User Research conducted: Conducted NPS, KANO analysis, and usability testing.

highlight-content: Transitioned from Sketch to Figma, improving team collaboration with real-time co-editing and faster communication.
Builded a design system to re-organize the guideline and UI kits, reducing onboarding time and maintenance cost.
NPS scores have steadily increased since 2019, reflecting higher customer satisfaction and better user experience.
Improved localization by standardizing term and design, creating culturally relevant interfaces to cater to Cambodian users.
Integrated research-driven design decisions, reducing trial-and-error costs by using annual KANO analysis to prioritize features based on actual needs.

content-en.title: Highlights & Challenges
content-en.subtitle: -Language & Layout Flexibility
content: Cambodian users primarily use three languages. The app had to support all of them.
1. Avoided fixed text box widths to allow for flexible rendering across languages.
2. Built translation glossaries to streamline wording and improve communication efficiency.

content-en.subtitle: -Cultural differences in terms
content: 1. Replaced banking jargon like “Transfer-in/out Account” with more user-friendly terms like “From/To Account” after usability testing.
2. Discussing with Cambodian to refine translations and enhance clarity and familiarity.

content-en.subtitle: -Build a unified design system
content: As a long-term project with frequent team changes, inconsistencies arose due to differing design approaches from different designers.

To keep consistency, I decided to switch tools from Sketch to Figma, organizing the App design guideline, and established Components & Library to ensure that future designers have guildline to follow.

content-en.subtitle: -User's Habits vs. Design Trends
content: 1. Users in Southeast Asia prefer a 3x3 grid homepage, contrasting with personalized dashboards common in Taiwan. In 2023, we redesigned the homepage using this layout based on local preferences and competitor research.
2. Later, we observed competitors shifting toward personalization, prompting reflection on whether to adapt user behavior or follow the mainstream design trends.

content-en.title: Reflections
content-en.subtitle: -Addressing Cultural Differences
content: Due to the significant cultural differences between Cambodia and Taiwan, this experience helped me step away from personal bias and design from the user’s perspective. During the design process, user interviews and usability testing allowed our team to validate assumptions. It made me realize the importance of conducting early-stage user research to better align the real needs and behaviors.

content-en.subtitle: -Data-Informed Feature Prioritization
content: Based on feedback from the homepage redesign and the low usage of some past features, I suggested that our team implement annual KANO analysis. This helps the business team focus on high-impact features and avoid wasting development time and resources.
